column3: The shift from plural hearing to singular telling is not marked.
“Obey Me” stands for hearing My voice.
“Again and again” resolves early rising and warning.
“Curses” specifies the words of the covenant.
Averting doom gives a different relation to the consecrated meat than its passing away from the addressee.
“Heart and mind” replaces kidneys and heart; “committed” renders revealing the case.
